L1 r19b ONE_OF/REST window gate: `sel.zone.kind is LIBRARY and sel.zone.position is TOP`. Rewrite: `top_library = [z for z in sel.zones if z.kind is LIBRARY and z.position is TOP]` and gate on that list being non-empty.
L1 gate clause 1 (zone.kind LIBRARY) — same ∃-predicate as :451.
L1 gate clause 2 (zone.position TOP) — must be the SAME matched zone as the kind test (∃ over one zone object, not two independent ∃s).

L1 BODY: `players_for_ref(sel.zone.controller, ctx)` — must extract the controller of the MATCHED LIBRARY+TOP zone (zones[i] that satisfied the gate), NOT the first/primary slot. An ∃-test that passes on a zone the body then ignores = silent rules change (gate A1).
union population `for extra in sel.zones: extend(...)` — set-iterate.

L2 (16a) PLAYER re-point: `sel.zone.kind is PLAYER` -> bind cards to their controller. Rewrite ∃ over sel.zones ONLY IF the gate means 'denotes players'; today the corpus selector is single-zone, so `zones == (PLAYER,)` is the faithful reading (see L3 pairing).
_is_any_universal already unions: `zones = (sel.zone, *sel.zones)` + any(ANY)/all(BATTLEFIELD). Fold: `zones = sel.zones` — semantics identical.

L3 role_handles player_side: `value.zone.kind is PLAYER and not value.zones`. Post-fold the faithful rewrite is SINGLETON-AND-KIND (`len(zones)==1 and zones[0].kind is PLAYER`), NOT ∃-PLAYER: a naive ∃ resurrects the r21a Magmutt/Leafkin re-point bug (printed damage aimed at the player instead of the walker).
L3 `and not value.zones` = 'primary only' test — becomes the cardinality test of the singleton rewrite above.
L4 role_handles graveyard_sweep: `value.zone.kind is GRAVEYARD` (Tormod's Crypt pin). Rewrite: ∃ z in value.zones with kind GRAVEYARD; keep the 5-pin AND-structure.
L4 second clause: `value.zone.controller is TARGET_PLAYER` — must ride on the SAME matched zone as :884 (one zone satisfying both), not an independent ∃.

L5 firemaw top-draw guard: `sel.zone.kind is LIBRARY` (with dest==HAND, non-partition, referent None, universal filter). Rewrite as SINGLETON-AND-KIND or all-zones-LIBRARY; a naive ∃-LIBRARY would let a HAND∪LIBRARY selector take the blind top-n DRAW lane.

*** NEW LANE (not in the known four) *** _ability_discards_its_source: `part.target.zone.kind is HAND` over CostDiscard.target (a Selector) + IS_SOURCE filter — the 'Discard this card:' activation-legality window gate. Rewrite: any(z.kind is HAND for z in part.target.zones).
enumerate_candidates union (`sel.zone` + `sel.zones`) then `handles = sorted(...)` — order-normalized, fold-safe.
extras loop — becomes the whole set.
_player_widening_applies unions then any(ANY)/all(BATTLEFIELD); identical shape to selectors._is_any_universal (the §8.3 query/runtime twin).

_fold_meta_filter rebuilds `Selector(value.count, value.mode, new_filter, value.zone)` — positional AND it DROPS value.zones (a latent union-loss bug TODAY: a meta-filtered TARGET selector loses its extra zones; corpus-blind because corpus twin TARGET selectors are not meta-filtered). Post-fold must be zones=value.zones.
field declaration: delete `zone: Zone`, make `zones: tuple[Zone, ...]` required (no default) — every positional site then fails LOUD at construction.

_SPECS['Selector'] field table drops ('zone','zone'), keeps ('zones','tup:zone') — from_dict raises on any stale 'zone' key (loud decode failure on pre-fold goldens).
_OMIT_IF_EMPTY['Selector'] = {zones, referent}: the zones-omission rule MUST be dropped (post-fold zones is load-bearing). Leaving it would serialize a no-zone selector as absent => silent data loss.
to_dict generic dataclass field loop: emits one key per field — byte delta is a consequence of the field set change, no code edit.
from_dict spec-driven decode (`missing fields` raise catches the old key; `tup:` default () would silently create a ZERO-zone selector unless __post_init__ requires >=1).
_set_sorted (SET-R1a canonical_json sort) — the precedent/helper the new zones normalization reuses.

slot_designations = {repr(slot.selector): (one,)} — repr(Selector) is the designation KEY; the fold changes the repr string but producer+consumer are the same live objects (no persisted repr key found).
atom_target_slot_key: `repr(value) in slot_designations` (consumer side of the same key).
atom_target_slot_key returns repr(value) as the shadow key.
spell_target_slots dedups TARGET selectors by repr key (slot identity/dedup).
activation_target_slots dedups by the same repr key.
_designate collects designation slots keyed by repr(selector) (multi-slot raise + binding key).
replace(selector, filter=stripped) — dataclasses.replace copies zones; fold-safe.
CLASSIFY row ('Selector','zones') -> 'SET-R0'; the V1-prime 25-field table + checker dict are single-source: deleting Selector.zone makes it 24 and the module's drift check must be re-baselined.
comment + NOTE 'R0 will delete it' — the detection-rule registry must drop the scalar row.

mode ALL returns `candidates` RAW in zone-enumeration order (primary zone entries, then each extra). The canonical_json sort puts GRAVEYARD before LIBRARY, so a multi-zone ALL selector's output order FLIPS. Corpus population TODAY: 0 (no ALL-mode selector carries zones) => register as latent.
_v_move_zone `pool[:n]` slices resolve order for non-partition finite moves (deterministic first-n).
CHOOSE mode sorts candidates -> zone-iteration order irrelevant.
enumerate_candidates sorts -> TARGET ask vocab (and its site_digest) unaffected by zone order.
designation asks `sorted(slot.candidates)` -> decision-handle site_digest stays stable.
